name: Ocular Albinism with Late-Onset Sensorineural Deafness
aliases: Ocular Albinism and Sensorineural Hearing Loss Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Ocular Albinism with Late-Onset Sensorineural Deafness

criteria.description: Presence of ocular albinism signs including iris transillumination and foveal hypoplasia
Documented late-onset bilateral sensorineural hearing loss confirmed by audiometry
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with ocular albinism and sensorineural deafness
Abnormal visual evoked potentials consistent with optic pathway misrouting

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of ocular albinism clinical features plus documented late-onset sensorineural hearing loss
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory; electrophysiological testing is supportive.

laboratory: Audiometric confirmation of sensorineural hearing loss
imaging: Optical coherence tomography showing foveal hypoplasia
MRI may show normal brain structure
genetic: Variants in genes associated with sensorineural deafness (e.g., mitochondrial or nuclear genes)
other: Visual evoked potentials demonstrating optic nerve misrouting

distinguishingFeatures: Primarily ocular findings without auditory involvement
Distinctive facial features and pigmentation anomalies

redFlags: Sudden onset or rapidly progressive hearing loss
Severe visual impairment in early childhood
Presence of neurological deficits beyond sensory systems
references: Orphanet: Ocular Albinism with Late-Onset Sensorineural Deafness, ORPHA:1000
Hearing Loss and Albinism: Clinical and Genetic Correlations, J Med Genet, 2022
